summary:
Having 8 Years of experience including Oracle Apps Finance-Functional consultant on Oracle Fusion Cloud and R12 Finance modules.
Experience in Implementation and supporting projects on P2P, GL and other Finance modules.
Conducted comprehensive workshops to gather business requirements, analyze processes, and map business requirements to Oracle Fusion
capabilities.
Conducted user training sessions and provided ongoing support to ensure successful adoption of Oracle solutions.
Resolved complex functional issues and performance bottlenecks, optimizing system performance and reliability.
Provided process enhancement strategies and created SOP documents to organize and stabilize the existing process.
Delivered post-production support and enhancements based on client feedback and evolving business needs.
